text:
alex: Heads-up — we're onboarding the Zelda customer org next week into eu-west-6. Need quota/entitlement bumps for GPU instances + networking to hit pilot SLA. Timeline: 2 weeks.

maya: Can you paste the exact numbers we should request? also which account ID?

alex: Account ID: 987654321098. Requesting: G5 (g5.48xlarge family) -> current 6, request 18; P5 (p5.48xlarge) -> current 0, request 4; p4d -> 0, request 0 (no p4d for this pilot). ENI per AZ -> current 40, request 220; VPC EIPs -> current 8, request 60; NAT Gateway throughput/allocations: 3 -> request 6.

sam: Cool. Why so many ENIs? are you planning multi-pod per GPU?

alex: Yes — each GPU node will host several inference pods and we need host networking + ENI-based IPs for isolation per tenant. Also some sidecars need public IPs for health checks.

jess: Do we have approval from finance for the reserved capacity cost if they exceed free credits? I can ping sales to confirm commitment.

mike: FYI, eu-west-6 has an odd subnet capacity allocation right now. We should avoid asking for burst in a single AZ, request multi-AZ distribution and call out NAT/GW IP requirement.

sam: I'm going to open the AWS Support case. Drafting now:
```
Service: EC2 - Increase 'Running On-Demand G5 instances' quota
Account: 987654321098
Region: eu-west-6
Current limit: 6
Requested limit: 18
Use case: Production pilot for inference platform (Redwood Dedicated pilot). We expect sustained throughput and will monitor usage; requesting multi-AZ capacity.
Cost center: infra-pilot-2026
```

sam: Also filing for ENI and Elastic IP increases:
```
Service: VPC - Elastic network interfaces per AZ
Current: 40
Requested: 220
Reason: multiple IPs per GPU host for tenant isolation and control-plane sidecars
```

maya: Tag the request with "business-impact:pilot" and attach the customer LOA (sales will send). That speeds entitlements.

alex: Sales LOA ETA is EOD today, will drop into this thread when available.

infrabot: [automated] New support ticket created: 1234567890 - AWS case opened for EC2 quota increase (G5) in eu-west-6. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?id=1234567890 (placeholder) :package:

sam: AWS rep replied: "We can process runway increase but need verification of account activity and billing contact." Asking for billing contact now.

jess: Billing contact: finance+pilots@redwood.ai. cc sales-eng.

mike: One caveat — if AWS can't grant p5 entitlement quickly, we should prepare fallback to g5-only with autoscaling policies tuned. Also add a model-quantization plan to reduce per-GPU footprint.

alex: Agreed. I'll add a canary config: start with 8 g5 nodes, warm KV caches, then scale to 16+ once quotas confirmed.

maya: @sam can you request ENI limits per AZ and also ask quota team about soft vs entitlement? We might need accelerator entitlement (for p5) which is different from instance limit.

sam: Yep I'll add: "Request accelerator entitlement for p5 family (accelerator-based allocation) if applicable."

aws-support-bot: [aws] Case 1234567890 updated: "Customer provided LOA, technical justification accepted. Pending operational review."

alex: Great. Two other asks: 1) Can we reserve a small block of public EIPs for health checks? 2) Can eng-infra provision a NAT gateway warm standby image so we can bring up extra NATs in region quickly?

mike: For 1) we'll request EIP pool increase. For 2) I have an AMI for NAT instances and a terraform module. I'll prep PR with runbook.

jess: Sales confirmed LOA attached and a 3-month paid pilot commitment so finance is green.

sam: AWS case moved to "awaiting fulfillment". They gave tentative ETA of 5 business days for G5 and ENI increases, longer (~10 business days) for accelerator entitlements.

alex: Thanks all. Action items: sam -> follow up on case and ping AWS AM; mike -> prepare NAT AMI + TF module PR; jess -> confirm billing contact & LOA attached; maya -> coordinate multi-AZ placement plan and fallback g5-only autopilot config.

mike: I'll tag infra-sre for NAT runbook review when PRs are up.

infrabot: [automated] Reminder in 2 days: follow up on AWS case 1234567890.

alex: Dropping the LOA here (uploaded): sales/attachments/zelda-loa.pdf (placeholder). Will update once quotas are fulfilled. :rocket:
